title: ClockResponse
description: The business clock after an advance.

business_now.description:
Business time now, such as `2026-11-07T09:42:10-07:00`, shown at America/Denver's offset
at that instant (`-06:00` in summer).

clock_offset_s.description: Seconds of business time ahead of wall time, 0 to 14 days.

clock_v.description: Counts the advances; a child that has not heard of the latest one is retried.
